firm_data.firm_description: Kosakoff & Cataldo LLP offers sophisticated litigation and other legal services to an array of clients, with a strong commitment to personal service, professionalism and integrity. The attorneys at K&C are problem solvers, working to find a cost-efficient solution to the unique problems of each of our valued clients.
notable_facts: Maintains a fully-staffed New Jersey office in Woodbridge, New Jersey
Available to serve as local counsel to attorneys from outside the Long Island area

email.subject: AI for Kosakoff & Cataldo LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jonathan,

With construction claims and commercial litigation driving your practice, you're solving complex problems on tight margins. That's exactly where most 9-attorney firms feel the squeeze.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by Melville to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete on speed and quality without the overhead.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
